notes: N-14 filed 2021-01-08 by Managed Portfolio Series for an open-end fund reorganization (Delaware U.S. Growth Fund into Jackson Square Large-Cap Growth Fund); mutual fund shares, no ticker printed. One passage prints the meeting year as 2020 (a typo); the notice and letter say March 23, 2021, which is used. Cover letter shows April [16], 2021 in brackets, the Q&A says on or around April 16, 2021. Target tax opinion is anticipated, not stated as a closing condition, so tax_opinion is not listed. The Summary of the Plan (where conditions would be listed) falls after the excerpt cut.
